authority: READ / RESEARCH / RECOVER / ANALYZE / PREPARE_PACKETS by default. Canonical writes require separate explicit bounded authority.
purpose: Trigger-driven worker selection over live FIELD authority. Presence in this file never creates NOW, priority or permission.
laws: CURRENT owns attention; QUEUE owns bounded execution capacity.
LLMS + transient transcript replace copied worker-state mirrors.
NO AMBIENT BACKLOG: an old packet cannot self-promote merely because it remains recorded.
RECOVERY REQUIRES A CONCRETE ANCHOR OR CURRENT BLOCKER.
ONE BOUNDED MOVE → VERIFY → RETURN → REPLAN.

transient_handoff.law: Compile after recovering the current checkout. Never commit the generated transcript as a second state store.

global_cycle: REORIENT: SCALE / OBJECT / STATE / DELTA / RECEIPT.
Recover live authority, not a cached worker snapshot.
Produce one bounded delta/packet or explicit NO_GAIN/BLOCKED return.
VERIFY → RETURN → REPLAN. No automatic sequel.
